'''Xanthe Huynh''' is an American actress for the English-language [[dub]] of multiple {{pkmn|animation}} series, including {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Xanthe was born on June 22, 1987, in Orange, California, USA and became a voice actor as an adult. Xanthe joined the cast during {{aniseries|JN}}, voicing [[Lauren]]. After voicing a character in [[Pokémon Evolutions]], Xanthe gained her most notable role, voicing [[Liko]]'s classmate [[Ann]] during {{aniseries|HZ}}.
